SET(STEAMWORKS_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/public")

IF(NOT EXISTS "${STEAMWORKS_INCLUDE_DIR}/steam/steam_api.h")
    MESSAGE(FATAL_ERROR "Steamworks SDK headers were not found in ${STEAMWORKS_INCLUDE_DIR}.")
ENDIF()

IF(WIN32)
    IF(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
        SET(STEAMWORKS_LIBRARY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/redistributable_bin/win64/steam_api64.lib")
        SET(STEAMWORKS_RUNTIME "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/redistributable_bin/win64/steam_api64.dll")
    ELSE()
        SET(STEAMWORKS_LIBRARY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/redistributable_bin/steam_api.lib")
        SET(STEAMWORKS_RUNTIME "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/redistributable_bin/steam_api.dll")
    ENDIF()
ELSEIF(UNIX)
    IF(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(aarch64|arm64|ARM64)$")
        SET(STEAMWORKS_LINUX_ARCH linuxarm64)
    ELSEIF(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|amd64|AMD64|i[3-6]86|x86)$")
        IF(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
            SET(STEAMWORKS_LINUX_ARCH linux64)
        ELSE()
            SET(STEAMWORKS_LINUX_ARCH linux32)
        ENDIF()
    ELSE()
        MESSAGE(FATAL_ERROR "Steamworks does not support ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}; configure with -DENDURANCE_ENABLE_NETWORK=OFF.")
    ENDIF()
    SET(STEAMWORKS_RUNTIME "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/redistributable_bin/${STEAMWORKS_LINUX_ARCH}/libsteam_api.so")
ELSE()
    MESSAGE(FATAL_ERROR "Steamworks is not configured for this platform.")
ENDIF()

IF(DEFINED STEAMWORKS_LIBRARY AND NOT EXISTS "${STEAMWORKS_LIBRARY}")
    MESSAGE(FATAL_ERROR "Steamworks import library was not found: ${STEAMWORKS_LIBRARY}")
ENDIF()
IF(NOT EXISTS "${STEAMWORKS_RUNTIME}")
    MESSAGE(FATAL_ERROR "Steamworks runtime library was not found: ${STEAMWORKS_RUNTIME}")
ENDIF()

ADD_LIBRARY(Steamworks::Steamworks SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(Steamworks::Steamworks PROPERTIES
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${STEAMWORKS_INCLUDE_DIR}"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${STEAMWORKS_RUNTIME}")
IF(WIN32)
    SET_PROPERTY(TARGET Steamworks::Steamworks PROPERTY IMPORTED_IMPLIB "${STEAMWORKS_LIBRARY}")
ENDIF()
